components.explanation: The looping sprite clip: content/rudy/sheet/rudy_sheet.png, a 4 × 4 sheet of Rudy's 16 Assignment 2 frames (410 × 386 cells, packed by tools/pack_rudy_sheet.py outside game/), with its .import (mipmaps) and ATTRIBUTION.md; Look/Sprite slices it with hframes 4 and vframes 4 (content/rudy/rudy.tscn); the run and sword_run clips in animations/rudy_animations.tres key Sprite:frame on cells 1, 2 and 12, 13 at 0 and 0.125 s, discrete, length 0.25 s, LOOP_LINEAR, step 0.125. previews/run_preview.gd/.tscn is the fixture the run strips were captured from.

The committing action on a cutout rig: content/rudy/rig/ holds the body, blade and arc parts cut by tools/cut_slash_rig.py from CHAR-SWORD-SLASH.png, with their .import files and ATTRIBUTION.md; Look/SlashRig/Lean/Grip/Blade, Lean/Body and Lean/Arc in content/rudy/rudy.tscn; the slash clip in animations/rudy_animations.tres keys Grip, Lean and Arc at ticks 0, 2, 5, 11 and 17 of the phase table (17/60 s, LOOP_NONE, step 1/60). previews/slash_preview.gd/.tscn is the fixture the slash strips were captured from.

The one authority: Look/AnimationPlayer (content/rudy/rudy.tscn, callback_mode_process physics, autoplay empty) is the only writer of the Sprite's frame and visibility, SlashRig's visibility and the rig's keyed properties; content/rudy/rudy.gd's _pick_clip() is the state machine, a priority list that returns a clip name every physics tick, which _physics_process passes to RudyLook.play_clip() (content/rudy/rudy_look.gd), restarting the slash on every new swing; take_hit() ends a swing in any phase. project.godot names GL Compatibility and the input actions.

The headless tests of this layer: tests/test_rudy_clips.gd/.tscn, the read-back (51 checks: tracks resolve, key times, step, loop and update modes, frame range, the structure check, 30 NEGATIVE copies); tests/test_rudy_states.gd/.tscn (99, the real Main, every reachable transition); tests/test_rudy_edges.gd/.tscn (108 at 60 fps, 66 at 30: interrupts before, on and after each phase boundary); tests/test_rudy_pin.gd/.tscn (20, the behaviour pin, re-pinned).

return &"slash"
	var sword := gear == Gear.SWORD
	if not is_on_floor():
		var falling := velocity.y >= 0.0
		if falling and not _was_falling:
			_falls_sideways = absf(velocity.x) > 1.0
		_was_falling = falling
		if falling and _falls_sideways:
			return &"sword_fall" if sword else &"fall"
		return &"sword_rise" if sword else &"rise"
	_was_falling = false
	if absf(velocity.x) > 1.0:
		return &"sword_run" if sword else &"run"
	return &"sword_idle" if sword else &"idle"

Sfx.play(&"hurt")
	facing = -int(away) # he turns toward the hit
	_turn_time_left = 0.0
	_slash_clock = -1.0
	_invulnerable_left = invulnerable_time
	hit.emit()
	if not lost_gear and hearts <= 0:
		mode = Mode.DEFEATED
		velocity.x = 0.0
		defeated.emit()
	else:
		mode = Mode.HURT
		_hurt_time_left = hurt_time
		velocity = Vector2(away * knockback.x, -knockback.y)

The real Main in Godot 4.7.2 Compatibility, Movie Maker at 3840×2160 and 30 fps, scripted input (play-01): Enter on the title, the run from frame 51 (cells 1 and 2), rise and fall over the first spikes and the first goblin, the sword picked up mid-run on frame 168 (sword_run from cell 12), the stop on frame 180; then labelled replays, enlarged 2.5×: frames 108–127 at ¼× and 110–123 at ⅛× (cells 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1 …: no frame between, none doubled at the wrap), frames 158–189 at ¼× and 164–175 at ⅛× (cell 2 on frame 167, sword_run from cell 12 on 168).

The same capture: one slash standing, the rig shown on frames 198–205 (swing ticks 1 to 15, two ticks a frame; Grip −67.5, −53.3, 0, 25, 40, 45, 28.3, 18.3 in the run log), sword_idle again on frame 206; then labelled replays, enlarged 2.5×, at ¼× and ⅛×, and frame by frame (each game frame held 0.8 s) from frame 197 to 206.

The same capture: he turns left on frame 298 (Look flips), runs from frame 301 (sword_run), slashes while running on frames 315–323 and runs on in sword_run from cell 12 on frame 324, stopping on frame 338; then labelled replays, enlarged 2.5×: ¼×, ⅛× of the slash while running, frame by frame from 314 to 324 (each game frame held 0.8 s), and ½×.

Fixture captures r1 (first-tick offset), frames 29–35 and 38 of captures/slash/r1/, enlarged 2× nearest, drawn with --debug-collisions so the hitbox shows; each frame's swing tick, Grip and hitbox state read from logs/slash_preview_r1.log; and the state test's per-swing line from logs/test_rudy_states_60fps.log.

Fixture captures r1 at both tick offsets (captures/slash/r1/ and r1-second-tick/), enlarged 2× nearest, ordered by swing tick: 1 and 2 (startup into active), 10 and 11 (active into recovery), 16 and 17 (the end); each frame's tick, Grip and hitbox read from logs/slash_preview_r1*.log beside CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 6's table.

The same capture: rise (frame 87) and fall (99) over the first spikes and the first goblin, the run between; a slash from frame 221 with the slash key pressed again on swing ticks 1, 5 and 13 (each read, each ignored: one swing, sword_idle on frame 230); a slash from frame 254 with a jump read on swing tick 5 (airborne on frame 257, sword_rise on 263 after the swing ends, landing on 277); with labelled replays: the air at ½×, each swing at ¼× and ⅛×, enlarged.

Three Movie Maker takes of the real Main, each a fresh boot with scripted input that times the slash against goblin B walking into Rudy's back: play-01 (slash read on the second tick of frame 718, hit on swing tick 1, hurt on frame 719), play-02 (hit on swing tick 5, hurt on frame 371), play-03 (hit on swing tick 13, hurt on frame 371), each at 1.0×, as a labelled quarter-speed replay, and frame by frame around the hit (each game frame held 0.53 s), enlarged 2.5×.
